html: I recall that previously you said wikipages would only be nessisary for states with a considerable impact on the story of SR, but how would you feel about having a small-ish wiki page for a state in each defined region of a commonwealth? I think it would provide a more detailed look at each region of the US in 2160, whatever we can define as a "region," possibly put together some census divisions for at least the uh, terrestrial states? as in firmly placed on top of the crust of a world.<ac_metadata title="State wiki pages"> </ac_metadata>
